name: Campaign message TOPICS gold (150, blind)
instructions: BLIND topics gold for 25_message_topics.py. Code from the text alone; no model output is shown. The text is the classifier input (up to 3,000 characters; the Text length line says if it is cut); all posts are June 2026. Order is shuffled (the source sheet was sorted by party). 1) Relevant? YES if the post is a political/campaign message; NO if admin/service/greeting/ad/non-political filler (then primary topic is 'other' automatically). 2) PRIMARY topic: the ONE most central issue. 3) All topics (text, ids separated by |; primary optional -- added automatically; blank = primary only). TOPIC axis (pick the ONE most central issue; list ALL issues the post substantively touches). svo_war = war in Ukraine / СВО / mobilization / soldiers / veterans / defense / front support. economy_prices = economy / prices / inflation / wages / jobs / taxes / business / budget. social_welfare = pensions / benefits / social support / families / maternity capital / poverty. housing_utilities = ЖКХ / utility tariffs / capital repairs / yards / heating / water / waste collection. infrastructure_transport = roads / public transport / construction / bridges. healthcare = healthcare / hospitals / clinics / doctors / medicines. education = education / schools / kindergartens / universities / teachers. corruption_accountability = corruption / accountability to voters / oversight of officials / transparency. patriotism_values = patriotism / traditional values / history & memory / religion / family-as-value. opposition_repression = repression / detentions / foreign agents / political prisoners / free speech / criticism of authorities. ecology = ecology / landfills / environment / climate / green zones. agriculture_industry = agriculture / industry / production / import substitution. migration = migration / migrants / interethnic relations. youth_sport_culture = youth / sport / culture / events for residents. election_process = the campaign itself: calls to vote, turnout, observers, registration, generic 'support our party/candidate' with no substantive issue. other = none of the above / not campaign-related / everyday/admin filler. There is deliberately NO mode/specificity coding on this chunk. Pointer: campaign2026/validation/DECISION_RULES_PROPOSED_2026-09-28.md (PROPOSED bars).
